provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: legend at L133 labels only the last plotted pair's colors on an axes holding 14 lines; the no-op copy loop L49-57 has no effect.
audit_member_text: Assignments L50-L56 write each second-column element back to itself, so the entire second loop has no effect.

base_member_text: Waterfall offsets reach +60 cm (L69) but the axis y-range tops at 8.2 cm (L123) -- with these offsets only the unshifted gauge-10 pair falls inside the axis; the axis limits appear tuned for a different (smaller) offset scheme such as the skp=2 one in BM5_A_Plotter.m.

Model time /10 rescale (L40-46) implies 0.1-s time units in the station files; the 261.7 s shift differs from BM5_A_Plotter.m's 265.82 s for the same case directory -- which alignment is authoritative is not determinable here.
Model station elevations are not unit-converted while reference gauges are converted to cm (first 600 samples only, L59-67) -- same unit-consistency caveat as BM5_A_Plotter.m.
Header (L14-15) mentions gauge files like 'g4.txt' but data actually come from A.mat; header also says nothing needs uploading (L7-8), reflecting an NTHMP workshop template origin.

audit_member_text: Both length-based loops at L39-L57 use length(n4) while indexing n5 through n10; unequal station lengths can either index past shorter inputs or leave tails of longer inputs untransformed.
The L59-L67 conversion loop requires at least 600 elements in every g4..g10 series imported at L29 without checking lengths.

Every measured plot uses the same imported t with g4..g10 (L89,L94,L99,L104,L109,L114,L119) without checking vector lengths, and station inputs are indexed as two-column matrices without shape validation.
Only gauges 4..9 are vertically offset at L69-L85; gauge 10 is not, but the script gives no statement clarifying whether this asymmetry is intentional.

The legend at L133 supplies only two labels after fourteen plot objects were added at L89-L121; MATLAB associates them with only the first two plotted objects, which are g4 measured and n4 numerical rather than all seven pairs explicitly.
